message: No detected input validation: The endpoint directly accesses request_data['text'] without any type, structure, or range validation before passing it to the pipeline.

No detected untrusted source handling: The download_model_from_s3 function fetches weights and config from S3 over plain HTTPS using wget with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code in the data preparation path checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The DataLoader and HateSpeechDataset pipeline perform no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: Model weights and config are downloaded from a public S3 URL via wget with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before being loaded with torch.load.

No detected label distribution validation: The code supports class-balanced sampling but performs no explicit label distribution validation, class balance check, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or stress-test routines are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set being isolated from training data via signing/hashing, nor multiple independent metrics or any other metric-tampering protection mechanism in the evaluation pipeline.
No detected input sanitization: The endpoint directly accesses request_data['text'] with no null check, type validation, length limit, or schema enforcement before passing the text to the pipeline.
No detected output bounds checks: The predict method returns confidence and class label with no NaN checks, probability range validation, or threshold guards on the softmax output before returning.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model is text-based (hate speech classifier, not an LLM), there is no input filtering, content moderation, or injection defense of any kind in the inference path.
